name: Niki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Niki town emblem in maroon: a six-pointed star enclosing a ring and a stylised letter C.
history: Municipal flag of Niki, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 March 1965.

features.role: Niki town emblem — a six-pointed star enclosing a ring and a stylised letter C
